title: Theory that Oppenheimer's security hearing was really about UFOs
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Theory that Oppenheimer's security hearing was really about UFOs, about 1945-1954 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the head of the kangaroo court was a guy named Gordon gray who you know who

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, floats the idea that the security hearing held for Robert Oppenheimer, the physicist who led the atomic bomb work, was secretly about UFOs. He calls it a kangaroo court and notes that it was headed by a man named Gordon Gray, a name that, he says, also appears in the Majestic 12 document, a paper said to describe a secret group overseeing UFO matters, alongside figures like the mathematician John von Neumann. If true, it would mean one of the best-known security cases in American history hid a UFO secret.
